copy.curiosityHook: When ordinary lives quietly fracture into disturbing private pursuits, can any genuine bond actually survive?
copy.description: In Todd Solondz's ensemble drama, several individuals cross paths as they pursue personal fulfillment through actions that defy social norms, fueled by a desperate search for human connection.
copy.vibeSummary: Slow-burning, heavy, and thoughtfully provocative, offering an intense and challenging solitary watch.
copy.whyWatch: Blending biting comedy with deeply unsettling drama, this ambitious multi-narrative portrait takes an unflinching look at the uncomfortable lengths people go to feel understood.

allowedMaterial: Ensemble structure following multiple intertwined individuals
Search for human connection through socially disturbing actions
excludedMaterial: Explicit detailing of late-stage offenses or resolutions
